banner.demo: Demo environment. All campaigns, donors, and amounts are mock data. No real funds move.

footer.tagline: A non-profit, open-source lifeline for disaster relief. Every gift is recorded on-chain and released against verified proof of spend.

feed.eyebrow: Lifeline for humanity · powered by crypto
feed.lead: Fund verified disaster relief on Solana and Ethereum. Funds are held in escrow and released only against AI-verified proof of how they were spent.
feed.step1Body: Donate SOL, ETH, or stablecoins from your wallet, publicly or anonymously. Every gift is written to an immutable on-chain ledger.
feed.step2Body: Vetted requesters can't just take the money. Funds sit in a smart contract and release in tranches, never all at once.
feed.step3Body: Each tranche unlocks only after AI-verified photos and video prove how the last one was spent. You watch your impact, on-chain.

campaign.nextTranche: Next tranche unlocks once new proof passes review

leaderboard.lead: Ranked by total given, normalized to USD across Solana and Ethereum. Anonymous gifts stay private and aren't listed.

profile.noRecordBody: We couldn't find public donations for {{who}}. They may have given anonymously, or not yet given to a registered disaster.

apply.signedOutHeading: Sign in with X to <grad>request aid.</grad>
apply.signedOutLead: To open a relief campaign, sign in with your public X identity. We verify the public identity of every requester before a campaign goes live. No KYC, no documents.
apply.receivedBody: Your request {{id}} is in the diligence queue. The core team verifies the public identity and on-the-ground presence of every requester before a campaign goes live. No KYC, no middlemen.
apply.heading: Open a <grad>lifeline</grad> for your community.
apply.lead: Tell us who you are and what happened. We vet the public identity of every requester, then publish a proof-gated campaign across all chains. Funds stay in escrow and release only against verified proof of spend.
apply.summaryLabel: What happened and what is the money for?
apply.summaryPh: Flash floods cut off four villages. We need water, food parcels, and fuel for resupply convoys.
apply.note: Diligence is on public identity only. We never ask for IDs or documents.
